title: Teal Job Tracker UPDATES: Empowering Your Job Search Experience
description:
In this update, we address recent improvements to the Teal Job Tracker based on user feedback. Key changes include more empowering language such as 'I withdrew' and 'not selected', the ability to archive jobs, and the addition of an application deadline column. These updates aim to enhance your job search experience and better align with our mission to empower career growth. Watch for a detailed explanation and see how these changes can benefit your job search process.
